text:
Sophie is portrayed as a brilliant scientist driven by a deep-seated altruism and a personal connection to the disease she seeks to cure. Her primary motivation stems from her youth, where the illness affected her directly, fueling a lifelong dedication to finding a solution. Despite facing significant obstacles, including personal health setbacks and professional skepticism, she demonstrates remarkable resilience. Her character development highlights her ability to maintain hope and determination even when confronted with overwhelming odds, showcasing a strong moral compass and unwavering commitment to her cause.

The fluffy things in the sky rain comes from are clouds.
